notes.api_tokens: Add multiple tokens for different devices/users. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32
notes.gpio_pins: BCM GPIO pin numbers (not physical pin numbers)
notes.pulse_duration: Duration in seconds to activate relay (typically 0.5-2.0 seconds)
notes.host: 0.0.0.0 allows access from any network interface
notes.port: Port number for the API server
